The Invasive Cardiovascular "Cardiac Catheterization" Labs, aka Cardiac Cath Lab, are specialized invasive procedure rooms where diagnostic and interventional cardiac and peripheral-vascular procedures are performed under fluoroscopy on patients from neonate through geriatrics. The Cardiovascular Technologist (CVT) is an integral part of the Invasive team and is responsible for the monitoring and for the safe use of all cardiovascular equipment. The ideal incumbent will have experience or a strong knowledge base with the operation of hemodynamic monitoring equipment used for cardiovascular procedures in both the Cardiac Catheterization and OR settings. Duties include: invasive hemodynamic monitoring and recording pre/post procedure preparation including patient transport as required, digital imaging processing (e.g.; IVUS/ OCT etc.), assistance with inventory control and supply management/usage, and assists in maintaining a safe work environment. Under the direction or supervision of a physician, the CV technologist (non RT) may assist with table or patient movement only under direct supervision and only when fluoroscopy is off. They must not operate the pedal, change imaging modes, or perform any advanced fluoroscopy equipment functions. #CA-SB
